item.title: CTL MathCounts team participates in state competition
item.description: The MathCounts team from the Center for Teaching and Learning in Edgecomb participated in the state competition which coincided with Pi Day, March 14. The event was held at Kennebec Valley Community College in Fairfield. CTL qualified to participate by placing second at the regional competition in January.

item.title: Robert C. Grover Sr.
item.description: Robert Clair “Stub” Grover Sr., 95, passed away on March 18, 2026, in Damariscotta, Maine. Born on April 15, 1930, in Bath, Maine, to Leon H. Grover and Minnie M. (O'Clair) Grover, Robert lived a long and fulfilling life dedicated to his family, career, and passions. After graduating high school, Robert answered the call to serve his country by joining the U.S. Navy in 1948 during the Korean Conflict. item.title: Crisis averted
item.description: Dear Editor: I want to publicly thank Maria and Andrew at Nathan's Pharmacy. Sunday morning we realized our son was out of enough insulin to get him through the next two days. Panic ensued. I contacted Maria and told her the problem. I had forgotten to pick up his prescription on Saturday before they closed. I wasn't worried at the time because I thought he had enough. He didn't. Without that insulin he most likely would have ended up in the ER again with high sugar levels.

item.title: Registration opens for hands-on ocean science program for teachers this summer
item.description: Registration has officially opened for BLOOM Educators, Bigelow Laboratory for Ocean Sciences' professional development program offering hands-on training for middle and high school teachers.

item.title: BRHS alumna among the acapella singers
item.description: University of Maine’s University Singers peformed for the first time at Boothbay Region High School March 20. Among the acapella performers was BRHS 2024 graduate Suzannah “Suzie” Edwards. Like all members of this choir, Edwards auditioned to become part of this extraordinary group of singers. She is also a member of one of the two smaller Singers groups, U Maine Renaissance, an all-treble group. The Maine Steiners is comprised of tenor-bass singers.
